versions.content: If LinIf_HeaderIndication is called while the confirmation of a response transmission is expected, the LIN Interface shall consider the transmitted frame as lost. Therefore, the LIN Interface shall report the runtime error code LINIF_E_RESPONSE to the Default Error Tracer. Afterwards, the received LIN Header shall be processed.
